verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mastra as a TypeScript-only framework: llms.txt describes 'a modern TypeScript stack', and community users call it 'TypeScript-first' and 'best in class for TypeScript'. Nothing in the pack shows Python, Go, or other language SDKs, so cross-SDK feature parity cannot be credited. A multi-language SDK axis is a fair question for a workflow framework, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I author workflows in the language my team already uses — TypeScript, Python, Go, or more — with real feature parity across SDKs
